question: On fresh lawful knot-grown starts, how long do a blind bot, a one-bit food reader and a tabular reinforcement learner survive?
inputs: One bit of food (masked for blind), energy, own previous action, anonymous legal movement ports; original ordinary funded growth under both laws.
forbidden_inputs: No hidden law, holder or distinction identities, physical coordinates, seed, turn counter, remote rations or test feedback in any policy.
mapping: Frozen named baselines and fitted Q values. Every action is eat or a concrete shared distinction at the current holder.
primary_observable: Completed game turns to actual death, including the fatal turn, on paired held-out founder structures; lifetime gaps with whole-start bootstrap.
comparators_or_controls: First-move alternating blind, class-balanced random blind, one-bit sensing script, frozen tabular Q learner. Same exogenous growth and independent reset for each.
resource_budget: 128 distinct training founders, 64 disjoint evaluation founders, two laws, four matched evaluation tapes, 12 training passes and two complete growth attempts per game. No censoring.
first_executable_signal: Scripted seeded resets under both laws, actual shared-name moves, depleted rations and death before fitting.
stop_rule: Report complete held-out comparison regardless of whether learning wins, ties or loses, and deliver a playback plus seed replay.
nonclaims: This is supplied game physics and an external learner. The measured contrast does not show native sensing, a learned knot mechanism or identification of the hidden law.
